metadataRaw.title: Fix a Neck Hump with One Move
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows one easy move to help reduce the unsightly appearance of a neck hump, also known as a dowager's hump.

This exercise will focus on letting gravity do all the hard work by stretching area around the neck hump, and flattening it over time.

This exercise is gentle enough to do daily, or 2-3x to help prevent a neck hump. 

Let us know how it works for you!
